promotionalIdeas.name: Rhino Radio w/ANIMAL
promotionalIdeas.concept: Monthly podcast showcasing the music we play in the club, interviews with entertainers, guests, and music artists.
promotionalIdeas.format: ~1 hour episodes. Behind-the-scenes interviews, industry talk, entertainment culture, track highlights from Saturday nights.
promotionalIdeas.distribution: Mixcloud (primary) — blanket music license coverage. Spotify/Apple Podcasts TBD if we can secure proper licensing.
promotionalIdeas.integration: Clips feed social media; influencers get podcast feature as comp; promotes upcoming events
promotionalIdeas.copyrightSolution: Use Mixcloud as primary host — they have blanket licenses for music. For podcast platforms: use short music clips (under 30 seconds) with commentary, or license-free/podcast-safe music for intro/outro. Interview segments and talking content are 100% original and copyright-free.

promotionalIdeas.name: Influencer & Street Team Program
promotionalIdeas.concept: A unified outreach program targeting three groups: social media influencers, nightlife insiders (bouncers and bartenders at other clubs), and grassroots street team activators. All three drive new traffic through authentic relationships — not paid ads.

tiers.label: Tier 1 — Social Media Influencers
tiers.who: Local Instagram and TikTok creators. Micro (5K–15K), Mid (15K–50K), Macro (50K+).
tiers.goal: 20–30 active influencers per month posting organic content about their SRB experience.

tiers.label: Tier 2 — Nightlife Insiders (Bouncers & Bartenders)
tiers.who: Door staff and bartenders at downtown Boise bars and clubs. These people talk to hundreds of guests every weekend — they are the most trusted referral source in nightlife.
tiers.discovery: Direct outreach to The Bastion, Neurolux, and other bars within 5 miles. Ish's existing network is the starting point.
tiers.goal: Turn industry workers into organic ambassadors who mention SRB to guests looking for where to go next.

tiers.label: Tier 3 — Street Team
tiers.who: Promoters, regulars, and motivated guests who want to hustle for perks. Activated at last call (1:30–2am) near downtown bars.
tiers.discovery: Ish's promoter network. Regulars who already love the venue.
tiers.goal: Drive last-call crowd directly to SRB. Especially effective for Saturday Late Night.

valueExchange.description: What we offer in exchange for presence and organic promotion. Mix and match by tier:

options.label: Option A — VIP Experience Package
options.details: Free admission + up to 3 guests. Reserved seating or VIP table. 0 bar tab. Personal DJ intro for behind-the-scenes content.
options.bestFor: Social influencers (Tier 1). High perceived value, low actual cost.

options.label: Option B — Rhino Radio Feature
options.details: Guest spot on Rhino Radio podcast. Promoted on SRB social channels before and after. Cross-audience exposure.
options.bestFor: Lifestyle/personality influencers building their own brand.

options.label: Option C — Social Media Collaboration
options.details: SRB reposts and tags their content. Co-created Reel or TikTok — we provide the venue, they own the content.
options.bestFor: Mid and macro influencers who want premium content.

options.label: Option D — Industry Perks (Bouncers & Bartenders)
options.details: Industry rate or free admission on their night off. Drink specials. Treated like VIPs when they walk in. Reciprocal relationship — we support their venue, they support ours.
options.bestFor: Tier 2 nightlife insiders. No cash — just mutual respect and access.

options.label: Option E — Referral / Affiliate Comp
options.details: Unique QR code or entry card per person. –10 credit per verified guest brought in. Top referrers get escalating perks.

promotionalIdeas.activation: Flyers and QR code cards for street team. Direct DMs for influencer outreach. In-person visits to neighboring bars to build bouncer/bartender relationships.
promotionalIdeas.tracking: Each person gets a unique QR code or entry card. We log who came in, who posted, guests attributed, and reach/impressions. Weekly review. Monthly rollup shows ROI per person. Full dashboard tracking planned — ready to build when volume justifies it.
promotionalIdeas.notes: Relationship-first across all three tiers. Never require a post. Never force a referral. The experience sells itself — our job is to make sure the right people are in the room.

promotionalIdeas.name: Content Creation & Social Media
promotionalIdeas.concept: Behind-the-scenes, crowd moments, DJ highlights, influencer collabs. Daily stories + 3–5 posts/week on Instagram, 2–3 videos/week on TikTok.
promotionalIdeas.format: Content pillars: Behind the Scenes, Guest Moments, DJ Sets, Influencer Collabs, Podcast Clips
promotionalIdeas.integration: All content feeds back into event promotion and podcast content engine
promotionalIdeas.notes: May need videographer if quality demands increase.

promotionalIdeas.name: Featured Entertainer Weekends
promotionalIdeas.concept: We're selecting one entertainer per weekend to take the stage as our Featured Entertainer — a dedicated, fully produced showcase designed to captivate our guests on both Friday and Saturday night. Your performance takes place after Midnight Showtime, during the Dance Special. Selected entertainers will join 1–2 rehearsal & strategy sessions with Animal to create a fully themed, immersive show experience for our guests.
promotionalIdeas.format: One entertainer per weekend · Both Friday & Saturday · After Midnight Showtime · 1–2 rehearsal & strategy sessions with Animal · Fully themed, immersive show experience
promotionalIdeas.distribution: Custom flyer per entertainer · Instagram · TikTok · In-club announcements · Podcast shoutouts
promotionalIdeas.integration: Featured entertainers feed podcast and social content. Builds star power and gives guests a reason to return every weekend.
